xBRIEFInfo.author: overdeck/0.0.0
xBRIEFInfo.description: Plan for PAN-5611: Idle-settled conversations stay in Settled after the operator resumes them, hiding them from their project group

plan.title: Idle-settled conversations stay in Settled after the operator resumes them, hiding them from their project group
plan.author: agent:claude-opus-5-5

narratives.Problem: The idle sweep (PAN-4655) settles a conversation with reason 'idle' after N days without activity, but nothing clears that settle when activity resumes. Only the explicit Unsettle (unsettleConversation) and a schedule fire (clearConversationTriage) clear a settle. The frontend places any root with settledAt in the Settled section (sectionOf), so a conversation the operator is chatting with stays hidden from its project group. Handoff and /clear successors are display children of the settled original, so the bug also hits the common case of working in a successor.
narratives.Proposal: Add a guarded store door resurfaceIdleSettledConversation(name, nowMs, settledAtMs?) that clears only settle_reason='idle' settles and restarts the idle clock. FR-1: the message route's receipt callback calls a new helper resurfaceIdleSettleAfterMessage(name, status) on a 2xx response; it clears the idle settle on the messaged row and its display root (D27 rule via a new displayRootNameOf helper), invalidates the list enrichment cache and emits conversation.schedules_changed. FR-2: a new resurfaceActiveIdleSettles pass, run by the idle-settle service before the settle pass, clears an idle settle on a root when a group member is live and some member's transcript activity is newer than settled_at, writing through the door guarded on the settled_at it read. Manual and merge settles are never cleared. Docs and changelog describe the new behavior. Full detail: .pan/drafts/PAN-5611.md.
narratives.NonGoals:
- Resurfacing settles with reason 'manual' or 'merge', or settled rows whose stored reason is NULL or unknown
- Unsnoozing a snoozed conversation when it receives a message or activity
- Changing the Resume route, the triage route (POST /api/conversations/triage), or the schedule service's unconditional clearConversationTriage
- Treating opening or reading a conversation (last_attached_at) as activity for resurfacing
- Adding a new domain event type, a schema migration, or any frontend change
- Changing settleConversation so that a re-settle over an idle settle replaces its reason
- Resurfacing from inside handleConversationMessage for its non-route callers (PR-watch notifier, trigger hooks, shared-session submit queue, scheduled-message delivery); the FR-2 sweep covers them
- Raising any scripts/file-size-allowlist.txt row

autoDecisions.summary: FR-1 clears the idle settle on the messaged conversation and on its display root.
autoDecisions.rationale: Handoff and /clear successors are display children of the original (displayParentId falls back to parentConversationId) and the sweep settles only roots, so clearing only the messaged row leaves the group in Settled in the most common case.

autoDecisions.summary: FR-1 runs inside the delivery receipt callback, on any 2xx response, including /pan composer commands and native compact.
autoDecisions.rationale: A receipt replay never calls the callback, so retries cannot resurface twice; any accepted composer input is operator use of the conversation. Non-2xx responses resurface nothing and FR-2 catches a delivery that did land.

autoDecisions.summary: Use a new guarded door resurfaceIdleSettledConversation instead of clearConversationTriage.
autoDecisions.rationale: clearConversationTriage is unconditional and would clear manual and merge settles, violating FR-3; a single guarded UPDATE also wins races against a concurrent settle.

autoDecisions.summary: Emit conversation.schedules_changed after a resurface rather than adding a triage event.
autoDecisions.rationale: The issue prescribes doing it the way the schedule service does; the reducer already bumps conversationsListRevision so the Command Deck refetches.

autoDecisions.summary: FR-2 reuses readTranscriptLastActivityMs with settled_at as the cutoff, including its modified-time fallback.
autoDecisions.rationale: turnRecordTimestamp parses only Claude-format records; non-Claude transcripts are append-only so modified time is their last write, and Claude's touch-without-record quirk is handled by the record-time branch.

autoDecisions.summary: FR-2 considers only idle-settled groups with at least one live member, and skips the tick when liveness is unknown.
autoDecisions.rationale: Pane-typed work needs a live session, and the filter bounds the steady-state transcript reads of a pass that otherwise runs over every idle-settled group every 15 minutes.

autoDecisions.summary: FR-2 runs even when auto_settle_idle_days is 0, and runs before the settle pass in each tick.
autoDecisions.rationale: Turning auto-settle off should not strand existing idle settles; running first lets the idle_reset_at it writes keep the settle pass from re-settling the row.

autoDecisions.summary: Resumes (including Resume all after a backend restart) resurface live idle-settled conversations through FR-2.
autoDecisions.rationale: PAN-4655 defines a resume as activity, and the resume contract makes the harness write transcript records; the operator chose to resume those conversations.

items.title: Add the guarded store door resurfaceIdleSettledConversation

narrative.Action: PRD WI-1. In src/lib/overdeck/conversation-triage-store.ts, after clearConversationTriage (line ~121), add exported resurfaceIdleSettledConversation(name: string, nowMs: number = Date.now(), settledAtMs?: number): boolean. It runs one UPDATE conversations SET settled_at = NULL, settle_reason = NULL, snoozed_until = NULL, idle_reset_at = ? WHERE name = ? Append the tests listed in PRD WI-1 to conversation-triage-store.test.ts using that file's existing temp OVERDECK_HOME pattern and helpers.

metadata.acJustification: Six criteria: five unit-level checks of the helper and route wiring, plus one end-to-end check (ac6) that only the test role can run against a dashboard built from this branch; it is the only observable proof that the Command Deck moves the row. The work agent closes ac6 on the strength of ac1-ac5 and the route diff, and must not start or restart a dashboard to try it.

narrative.Action: PRD WI-4. Create src/dashboard/server/services/conversation-idle-resurface.ts exporting ResurfaceAfterMessageDeps { listRows, resurface, invalidate, emitChanged } and resurfaceIdleSettleAfterMessage(name: string, status: number, deps = defaultDeps): string[]. Return [] unless 200 <= status < 300 (do not call listRows then). Otherwise root = displayRootNameOf(name, deps.listRows()); call deps.resurface for name and for root when different; collect names that returned true; call deps.invalidate() once when any changed and deps.emitChanged(n) for each; return them. Wrap the body in try/catch: on error console.warn('[conversations] idle resurface failed for <name>: <message>') and return []. Defaults: listConversations (src/lib/overdeck/conversations.ts), (n) => resurfaceIdleSettledConversation(n), invalidateConversationListEnrichmentCache (src/lib/overdeck/conversation-list.ts), emitConversationSchedulesChanged (src/lib/overdeck/conversation-schedules.ts). In src/dashboard/server/routes/conversations.ts postConversationMessageRoute (around line 624) change the withConversationMessageReceipt callback to an async function that awaits handleConversationMessage, calls resurfaceIdleSettleAfterMessage(name, response.status) with a '// PAN-5611 FR-1' comment, and returns the response (exact snippet in the PRD). Do not touch handleConversationMessage. Write the tests listed in PRD WI-4 against a real temp OVERDECK_HOME database with invalidate and emitChanged injected as vi.fn().

Add the resurfaceActiveIdleSettles sweep pass

expected_outputs: conversation-idle-settle.test.ts passes including the resurfaceActiveIdleSettles describe block

narrative.Action: PRD WI-5. In src/lib/overdeck/conversation-idle-settle.ts add exported IdleResurfaceDeps { now?, listRows?, listIdleClocks?, listLiveSessions, resolveTranscript, lastActivityMs?, resurface?, log? } and resurfaceActiveIdleSettles(deps): Promise<string[]>. Steps: read rows (default listConversations()) and clocks (default listIdleClocks()); candidates = groupByDisplayRoot(rows) groups whose root clock has settledAtMs !== null and settleReason === 'idle'; return [] when none before listing sessions. live = await deps.listLiveSessions(); when null log '[idle-settle] terminal sessions could not be listed; skipping resurface' and return []. Keep groups with at least one member whose tmuxSession is in live. With withConcurrencyLimit(..., TRANSCRIPT_READ_CONCURRENCY), for each member resolve the transcript (skip null), activity = await lastActivityMs(path, settledAtMs) (default readTranscriptLastActivityMs); when activity !== null && activity > settledAtMs call resurface(root.name, settledAtMs, nowMs) (default (n, s, t) => resurfaceIdleSettledConversation(n, t, s)), push the name when it returned true, and stop that group. Never read idleDays. Do not change sweepIdleConversations. Add the tests listed in PRD WI-5.

items.title: Given an idle-settled root with a live member whose transcript activity is newer than settled_at, the pass returns [rootName] and the root's triage reads empty; given activity at or before settled_at, it returns [] and the root stays settled
Given roots settled 'manual' and 'merge' with live members and newer activity, the pass returns [] and both stay settled

Given an idle-settled root whose only newer activity is in a child's transcript, the pass resurfaces the root; given an idle-settled group with no live member, it returns [] and resolveTranscript is never called for that group
When listLiveSessions returns null the pass returns [] and logs the skip line; the pass resurfaces with no idleDays dependency, so a 0-day setting does not stop it
Given an injected listIdleClocks reporting settledAtMs 1000 for a row whose database settled_at is 2000, the real door rejects the write and the pass returns [] with the row still settled
